uip maestro bpmn registry                            
Browse and search the Maestro BPMN registry to discover available extension types, connectors, and processes. Use 'pull' to sync, 'search' to find entries, 'get' to inspect full spec.
                Use --help with nested commands for more detail.                

┌─ Usage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ uip maestro bpmn registry [options] [command]                                │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ get      Get the full spec for a single extension type. Optionally enrich    │
│          connector types with live IS metadata.                              │
│ help     display help for command                                            │
│ list     List cached extension types and discovered resources (default:      │
│          first 30). Use --limit -1 for all.                                  │
│ pull     Fetch and cache the Maestro BPMN registry (login for full           │
│          discovery)                                                          │
│ search   Search the registry by keyword across extension types, connectors,  │
│          and processes                                                       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ -h, --help                     display help for command                      │
│ --output                       Output format (default: json)                 │
│ <table|json|yaml|plain>                                                      │
│ --output-filter <expression>   JMESPath expression applied to the Data field │
│                                of the response envelope                      │
│ --log-level                    Log level threshold (default: info)           │
│ <debug|info|warn|error>                                                      │
│ --log-file <path>              Write logs to file instead of stderr          │
│ --profile <name>               Use a named login profile                     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Typical workflow:
  0. Login for full registry (optional, OOTB types available without login):
                          uip login
  1. Sync the registry:   uip maestro bpmn registry pull
  2. Search for a type:   uip maestro bpmn registry search connector
  3. Inspect its spec:    uip maestro bpmn registry get <extensionType>
  4. Extract fields:      uip maestro bpmn registry get <extensionType> --output-filter "Data.ExtensionType"

Note: Without login, only built-in (OOTB) extension types are available.
      Login to discover connectors and processes from IS and Orchestrator.

Subcommands:
  pull    Fetch and cache the full registry (static + discovered resources)
  list    List cached extension types and discovered resources
  search  Find entries by keyword (extension type, connector, process name)
  get     Get full spec for an extension type (with optional IS enrichment)

uip maestro bpmn registry search queue --output json > registry-evidence/registry-search-queue.json 2>&1
echo "exit: $?"
cat registry-evidence/registry-search-queue.json
parameters.description: Filtered search for queue wrapper type

parameters.command:
uip maestro bpmn registry list --limit -1 --output json > registry-evidence/registry-catalog.json 2>&1
echo "exit: $?"
wc -l registry-evidence/registry-catalog.json
parameters.description: Capture full registry catalog as JSON evidence
